system.description:
The Etharch’s voice booms across the battlefield as he issues commands to his Sword Singers and vassals. This skill acts like Command. Also, all soldiers who have a trait, Instinct or Belief about the commander can hear his voice when he issues commands—no matter how far away they are on the battlefield.

Skill Type: Social. Tools: No.

Restrictions: Elves only

Root: Will/Forte (§ magical skill: tests are open-ended)

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 307
